messages:
maya: Quick ping — PR #61123 is ready for final review. Changes: routing fallback + small eviction tweak. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before we can schedule a canary. Who can own the canary and take the merge steward role?

sam: tagging runtime + infra. @eli @jordan can you take a look? we want a short canary (10–15%) and rollback plan ready. :eyes:

eli: I can own runtime canary. Quick Q — what perf numbers did staging show for 512-token seqs? p95/p99?

maya: staging p95 = 58ms, p99 = 220ms (same baseline). Batch size 32. No KV cache changes. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 30m, monitor p95, error rate, token cost. Rollback: immediate revert to previous route variant.

jordan: infra can do merge steward for the window, but I need the exact kube job name and the rollout flag. Also we need an outage blast radius doc for infra ops.

maya: kube job is rollout/routing-service-v2, flag = feature.routing_fallback_v2=true. Outage blast radius: only the routed subset; added runbook snippet below:

```bash
# quick rollback
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/routing-service ROLLOUT_TAG=stable
# scale down new pods
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/routing-service-v2 --replicas=0
```

kristen: Security check: we need KMS key usage audit and authz header order tests. @security-team can you confirm KMS policy review is cleared?

security-team: we'll run the KMS audit and confirm by EOD. Also request to add an integration test for auth header ordering (we'll queue it).

eli: one more thing — add a canary metric for average KV hit rate so we can correlate errors to cache behavior.

maya: will add metric and update PR. Planning to cut canary in the 9–10am PT slot tomorrow unless you ask otherwise. Jordan/eli — can you both ack that slot?

jordan: ack for 9–10am PT, i'll own merge steward.

eli: ack, i'll monitor runtime metrics and be on call.

sam: thanks all — maya, once you update PR with runbook and metric, ping this thread and i'll schedule the canary window and add the deploy-bot job. :thumbsup:

maya: will do, thanks everyone.
